strictness_note: No blanket pedantic-errors claim: legacy/compiler/vendor extension headers are permitted; standard config forces the known library fallback paths explicitly.
checked_mode: Renderer skip_runtime_checks=False; none of227 checked bodies internally defines SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS. SKIP version uses renderer prefix only.
snapshot_inputs: All current library bytes supplied through source_overrides, original driver bytes through driver_override; frozen common and ACL/vendor headers expanded by frozen prepare_verify renderer. All454 versions saved before any compilation.
checker: Frozen prepare_verify.matches and adjacent verify_graph_samples.py; token/float/independent custom checker selected by each entry. No acceptance decision based on online history.
cache_recipe: Exact codeSHA/compiler command/version/flags/compile timeout +sample/semantic-entry/checkerSHA/run timeout. Binary and source file hashes rechecked when finalizing. Unrelated code keeps its compile cache across new snapshots.
limits: Local checked/skip and fallback sample gate, not new online AC evidence or exhaustive API/domain proof.
Forcedstandard config exercises explicitly listed library alternatives; no blanket ISO-pedantic claim for legacy/vendor/compiler headers.
Results identify exact frozen bytes. Workspace drift is reported and requires a latest-snapshot resume for changed code before claiming those changed bytes pass.
